# CatHealth.com

> > A comprehensive veterinary guide to feline health conditions, diseases, and wellness written by veterinarians.

CatHealth.com is a veterinarian-authored resource providing detailed guides on cat health conditions, symptoms, and care. The site covers everything from common ailments to advanced veterinary innovations, supported by a free newsletter and community features.

## Key Topics

- Feline health conditions
- Veterinary information
- Cat symptoms and diagnosis
- Urinary system disorders
- Metabolic and hormonal diseases
- Cancer in cats
- Cardiovascular disease
- Infectious diseases
- Parasites and prevention
- Dental health
- Skin conditions
- Respiratory health
- Digestive disorders
- Senior cat care
- Veterinary innovations

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://www.cathealth.com): CatHealth.com homepage with latest feline care info and newsletter signup
- [Cat Health Guide Hub](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health): Main cat health guide hub with categories for feline conditions and symptoms

## Disease & Condition Reference

- [Urinary System](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/urinary-system): Guide to cat urinary health including kidney disease and urinary blockage
- [Metabolic & Hormonal Disorders](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/metabolic-and-hormonal-disorders): Reference on feline diabetes, hyperthyroidism, and diabetic ketoacidosis
- [Cancer](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/cancer): Reference on feline cancer types including hemangiosarcoma and fibrosarcoma
- [Cardiovascular](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/cardiovascular): Guide to cat heart disease including hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and thrombus
- [Infectious Diseases](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/infectious-diseases): Guide to viral infections, disease prevention, and zoonotic disease in cats
- [Digestive System](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/digestive-system): Reference on feline digestive disorders including pancreatitis and megacolon
- [Respiratory](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/respiratory): Guide to cat respiratory health including bronchitis and pneumonia
- [Parasites & Health](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/parasites-health): Guide to feline parasites including fleas, tapeworms, and toxoplasmosis
- [Skin](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/skin): Reference on feline skin conditions, allergies, and dermatology
- [Bone & Joint Conditions](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/bone-and-joint-conditions): Guide to cat arthritis and degenerative joint disease in senior cats
- [Neurological](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/neurological): Guide to neurological disorders and symptoms in cats
- [Oral](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/oral): Reference on feline dental health and oral conditions like stomatitis
- [Vision](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/vision): Reference on feline eye health and vision conditions

## Specialized Care Guides

- [Reproduction](http://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/reproduction): Reference on feline reproduction, spaying/neutering, and pregnancy
- [Alternative Medicine](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/alternative-medicine): Guide to holistic and complementary therapy options for cats
- [New Innovations](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/new-innovations): Coverage of veterinary advances including stem cell therapy for cats

## Community & Newsletter

- [Sign Up for the FREE Cat Health Newsletter](https://www.cathealth.com/sign-up-for-the-free-cat-health-newsletter): Newsletter signup page for free Cat Health Mewsletter via Mailchimp

## Optional

- [Smelly Cat](https://www.cathealth.com/cat-health/smelly-cat): Guide to identifying and addressing cat odor and hygiene issues
